prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix the same bug in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts: in JSON response mode, the server rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' because the validation requires both 'application/json' AND 'text/event-stream' to be present. prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that follows Accept-header semantics properly: it splits on comma, strips/evaluates q-parameters (treating q=0 as 'not accepted'), and matches type/subtype (including wildcards) rather than doing raw substring search. #2046's visible fix reduces to acceptHeader?.includes('application/json'), a substring check that would also match unrelated media types containing that substring (e.g. 'application/json-patch+json') and ignores q=0 exclusions. #1996's approach is the more spec-correct fix for the same bug, so it should be kept and #2046 closed as duplicate.
